verses.english: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard: “Monks, there are these two kinds of gifts: a gift of material things & a gift of the Dhamma. Of these two kinds of gifts, this is supreme: a gift of the Dhamma. There are these two kinds of sharing: sharing of material things & sharing of the Dhamma. Of these two kinds of sharing, this is supreme: sharing of the Dhamma. There are these two kinds of assistance: assistance with material things & assistance with the Dhamma. Of these two kinds of assistance, this is supreme: assistance with the Dhamma.”
the sharing the Blessed One has extolled:
who–confident in the supreme field of merit,
wouldn’t give it at appropriate times?
Both for those who proclaim it
confident in the message of the One Well-Gone:
